In this video we cover:
Swiggy vs Zomato Q1: Big Losses, Bigger Quick Commerce Battle
Swiggy and Zomato have posted their Q1 FY26 results—revealing heavy losses and very different strategies in quick commerce. Swiggy may exit Rapido, which is now a rival. Blinkit is expanding fast, while Instamart focuses on efficiency but still faces bigger losses. With growing competition from Zepto, Amazon, Flipkart, and Tata, the quick commerce war is heating up.
